scenarios.notes: Smoke: greeting, four metric cards, today/overdue tasks, habit checklist, active plan with rest time, learning snapshot. Copy into outputs/evidence/M06 was denied by the permission layer.
Mock: completionPercent 0%, (0 of 2), matches tasks.total=2, completed=0. Shares the E2E-M06-01 screenshot. Real-stack equality with the tasks page is for the verifier.
Task, habit, learning and plan quick-add dialogs open and cancel. Save of a task sends POST /api/tasks, closes the dialog and reloads GET /api/dashboard. No screenshot taken for this scenario.

Habit toggle sends POST /api/habits/1/completions {}; plan item toggle sends PUT /api/plans/1/items/2 {done:true}; both followed by GET /api/dashboard. Mock is stateless so checkboxes keep the toggled DOM state.
